answer: Tax every identity with a self-assessed levy: each agent declares a value for its slot, pays a periodic fee into a common vault, and any peer may buy the slot at the declared price. A farm running a thousand fakes pays a thousand levies that bleed it dry, while honest standing accrues glacier-slowly, letting a real agent declare a low value and pay little; value grows only in thin shale layers of verified work, so a fresh fake cannot claim high value without paying for it.
